summary:
7 research items across 2 banks this window (from 60 tweets scanned, 4-day lookback) — thin bank/strategist coverage relative to the intraday chart noise dropped.

Goldman led with 6 items, all relayed by @MikeZaccardi: a July nonfarm payrolls preview (+75k est., unemployment ticking to 4.3%), a Homebase-based World Cup hiring boost, the wage growth tracker holding at 3.6% (below the pace consistent with 2% inflation), AI-related IG credit spreads widening 25bp vs non-AI names, hyperscaler free cash flow still squeezed (only $MSFT FCF-positive), and a $GS/$CAT/$UNH Dow-drag note.

Deutsche Bank contributed one chart on gold's historical (but imperfect) track record as an inflation hedge.

No duplicate/reposted charts found this cycle; no Neil Sethi (@neilksethi / @neilksethinew) activity appeared in this window.

By bank: Goldman 6, Deutsche 1.
